Louvre to hike ticket prices for most non-EU tourists by 45%
item.description:
📝 Louvre to hike ticket prices for most non-EU tourists by 45%6 hours agoShareSaveOsmond ChiaBusiness reporterShareSaveGetty ImagesThe Louvre museum received nearly 9 million visitors in 2024Ticket prices for the Louvre museum in Paris will rise by 45% for most non-European Union visitors, the museum's board decided on Thursday. Non-EU visitors in groups with accredited guides will also have to pay €28 starting next year, the Louvre told the BBC. The Louvre received nearly 9 million visitors last year, with the majority coming from abroad.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyd4llgrego
